subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a public per-agent-model generation/request timeout surface, and if so what key names and precedence should it use relative to `agents.defaults.timeoutSeconds`, `models.providers.<id>.timeoutSeconds`, first-event timeout, and the idle watchdog?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding the field changes public config and fallback behavior that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product surface.

options.title: Define per-model timeout
options.body: Approve a typed agent-default/per-model timeout with schema, docs, precedence, fallback handling, and focused tests.

options.title: Use existing surfaces
options.body: Decline the new key and document provider timeout, run timeout, first-event timeout, and idle watchdog as the supported operator controls.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Keep this issue scoped to total generation budget and route thinking stalls or repetition loops to their narrower open trackers.

recommendation.title: Define per-model timeout
recommendation.body: Approve a typed agent-default/per-model timeout with schema, docs, precedence, fallback handling, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the prior detailed review on this item and is the strongest current routing candidate for the product/config decision.
